# DSH Bar
An animated whale in the macOS menu bar for **DeepSeek Harness** — see and steer the agent without s
in the macOS menu bar for **DeepSeek Harness** — see and steer the agent without switching windows.
## What it does
| State | Menu bar |

| Idle | still whale |
| Thinking / tool running | swimming whale + spout |
| Waiting for approval |

red dot (and a count when questions are also waiting) |
| Done | short "done" flash, then idle |
|

Error | stays until the next turn starts |
| DSH not running | dimmed whale, popover says why |
Left click opens the popover: session title, current step/tool, model, tokens, **Approve/Deny** for
held tool approvals (with a 1/N queue), **answer questions** right there (radio / checkbox / free te
xt), the session list, **Stop**, **Open DSH**, **Quit**. Right-click: Open DSH, Stop, Settings, Chec
k for Updates, Launch at Login, Quit.
## The whale
The mark is code, not an asset: WhaleIcon.swift draws the body oval, swinging flukes, fin, three spo
ut drops and a transparent eye hole into a 22 pt template image, so macOS tints it for light and dar
k menu bars. Twelve frames at 12 fps run only while the agent is thinking or running a tool; other s
lve frames at 12 fps run only while the agent is thinking or running a tool; other states are still.
- answer `ask_user_question` prompts from the popover — single select, multi select, custom text, mu

ltiple questions per prompt;
- approvals queue: "1 of N" with Previous/Next instead of silently hidi

**en / ru / zh-Hans** (system language);
- native tests (decode, answer batch, version compare) in

en / ru / zh-Hans** (system language);
- native tests (decode, answer batch, version compare) in CI.
- long questions and long session lists **scroll** inside the popover instead of growing past the sc

coloured dot instead of the whale (Settings);
- smoother recovery after a display change: the popove
r re-runs its size pass.
- **instant updates** over Server-Sent Events (`GET /dsh-bar/events`); the 0.8 s poll stays as a saf

ety net and for reconnects;
- **global hotkey ⌥⌘D** toggles the popover from any app (Settings can d

isable it);
- **0.4.1:** redrew the whale — big head, mouth line, broad raised fluke and pectoral fi
n, instead of the fish-like oval.
## Download and install (free)
### Homebrew (recommended)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Manual
Download `DSHBar-0.4.1-macos-universal.zip` from the latest release, unzip into `/Applications`, and
on first launch right-click → **Open** (or `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/DSHBar.app
`). The bundle is **ad-hoc signed** — there is no paid Apple Developer ID, so no notarization.
### Host plugin
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Add `"dsh-bar"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in that profile's `package.json` and reload DSH.
### About notifications
macOS only registers apps with Apple-issued signatures for Notification Center, so an ad-hoc build g

ets
`Notifications are not allowed for this application`. DSH Bar detects this and shows a **floatin

g card** near the menu bar instead:
approval title, tool and reason, with **Open DSH** / **Deny** /
**Dismiss**. Approve stays in the popover on purpose — the tool arguments are not visible in a banne

r.
If you build locally and sign with your own Apple Development certificate, real notifications (in
cluding the Deny action) start working automatically.
## Architecture
- **`plugin/` — `dsh-bar` host plugin** (npm). Writes `$DSH_HOME/dsh-bar/runtime.json` (`0700`/`0600
`), mounts `/dsh-bar` on the Host web server, folds session events into a state document, holds `app
roval/request` and `user-questions/request` waterfalls so the bar can answer them, and serves a brow

ser half that opens a session through `ctx.uiWorkspace.openSession`.
- **`app/` — native menu bar ap
p** (Swift, AppKit + UserNotifications). Reads `runtime.json`, polls `GET /dsh-bar/status` with a Be
arer token, posts approvals/answers/stop/focus.
Security: loopback only, Bearer token on every native route, page routes use same-origin/bridge trus
t instead of putting the token in page JS. Only titles, tool names, question text and usage counters
cross the bridge — never message bodies.
**Approvals note:** the shipped `danger-full-access` preset uses `approval: never`, so approvals nev
er reach the bar. Use the `read-only` or `workspace-write` preset to see Approve/Deny.
## Endpoints
| Method + path | Auth | Purpose |

| `GET /dsh-bar/status` | Bearer | state document (sessions, approvals, questions) |
| `GET /dsh-bar

/health` | Bearer | liveness |
| `POST /dsh-bar/approve` | Bearer | `{id, outcome: "allowed-once" \\

| "rejected"}` |
| `POST /dsh-bar/answer` | Bearer | `{id, answers: [{id, selected, custom?}]}` |
|

`POST /dsh-bar/stop` | Bearer | `{sessionId}` |
| `POST /dsh-bar/focus` | Bearer | `{sessionId}` |
|
`GET /dsh-bar/pending-focus` | page trust | focus wish for the page half |
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Debug without the menu bar: `DSHBar --dump-status`, `--notification-status`, `--alert-test`.
Environ

ment overrides: `DSH_BAR_RUNTIME_FILE`, `DSH_BAR_DEMO=1`, `DSH_BAR_AUTOANSWER=1`
(test hook: opens t
he popover and clicks the first option + Send — used for the end-to-end question test).
## Roadmap

- **0.1** — native shell, animated whale, live state ✅
- **0.2** — questions, approvals queue, sessi

ons, settings, locales, update check, tests ✅
- **0.3** — scrollable popover, 8 sessions, status-dot

mode ✅
- **0.4** — SSE push, global hotkey ✅
- **0.5** — session search, richer notification cards
